description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Nikapothagama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District. (25/0279)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, and encumbrances - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category definition for land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
